newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Norway's royal couple to visit Czech Republic.
newsitem.headline: Norway's royal couple to visit Czech Republic.

text.p: Norway's King Harald and Queen Sonja will make a state visit to the Czech Republic in March, a spokesman for Czech President Vaclav Havel said in a statement.
Ladislav Spacek said the visit on March 18-20 comes at the invitation of Havel, who is currently in an Prague intensive care unit recuperating from lung surgery performed on December 2.
Doctors removed a small malignant tumour along with half of his Havel's right lung and he has been in serious condition after complications from the surgery.
The prognosis for a full recovery, however, is good, doctors said earlier this week.
